Attendance, participation, assignments and a final business plan (with a business presentation).

sections.content: The content is not too hard! Most of it is interesting as I was able to learn new concepts about startups. I personally would recommend to buy or borrow the assigned textbook as it is very helpful. I have attached the syllabus below for further information.
sections.teaching: He is one my favourite professors at UST. He makes the 3 hour class super interesting and engaging with his personal business opportunities and experiences. He also has a habit of repeating himself multiple times during the lecture so you may not have to read the textbook to remember certain concepts.
sections.grading:
Grading was great!

Individual Attendance = Attended all classes as they were very interesting

Class Participation = Actively participated during lectures

Quizzes = Both quizzes were above mean (mean = around 25/30)

Final presentation = the score was not released but according to professor's feedback he was very impressed with our presentation

Final Grade = A
sections.workload: Workload is not too heavy as the quizzes are based on individual performances. However, things were chaotic during the preparation of final presentation as we had to deal with 2 free riders.

sections.content: The content is all about your creativity, if you can think of a  good idea, and you are a good pitcher, it's a pretty nice course.
sections.teaching: Teaching is alright I think. Not too bad not too good.
sections.grading: Some people said his grading is harsh but I think he looks a lot into effort. If you can show him the effort your group put in, you will be fine.
sections.workload: He warned us about the workload so i think everyone who take this course is prepared for the heavy workload. Reading every lesson and many preparations to do. He will cold call on students to answer his questions so you can hide.

sections.content: The course mainly focus on entrepreneurship and innovation in business, the whole lecture time is mainly focusing on the content from the textbook and some day to day example from professor, the content is somehow boring.
sections.teaching: Professor teaching style is really boring and wordy, he keeps repeating the facts and information from the textbook which the students can read the book themselves instead of mentioning over and over again during the precious lecture time. He also invite students to recap his teaching and textbook every lecture, which it is considered as wastage of time.
sections.grading: The grading is pretty good, i think the grading really depends on the performance of the group project, if you can catch his attention of your project idea at first and keep it up, it's easy to obtain at least B+ from him.
sections.workload: The workload is crazy and heavy, it requires every group to write a formal business plan of 30 pages, as well as a 15 minutes presentation for the project.

sections.content: All the things are from textbook. Read the textbook. From business model, marketing to funding. A snapshot of all the business topics. There is nothing difficult for this course.
sections.teaching: Not that good. He was very lack of insights on entrepreneurship. The course itself is good but the instructor is to some extent very bad.
sections.grading:
It's ok.

Attendance, participation, assignments and a final business plan (with a business presentation). The presentation is to a VC guy and a banker.
